reported_context.session_intent: Complete the coach-authored 3x8-minute indoor Suito tempo/torque session while outdoor haze prevented riding.
reported_context.rep_by_rep_rpe_status: Athlete reported the eight-minute repetitions collectively as exceeding RPE 6 and feeling approximately RPE 8; separate ratings for repetitions one, two and three were not reported.
reported_context.continuation_reason: Athlete continued after the written RPE ceiling was exceeded because he believed completing the exercise was necessary to increase VO2max.
reported_context.rpe_scale_guardrail: Athlete report uses a conventional 0-10 scale. Garmin post-activity directWorkoutRpe was 80/100 and directWorkoutFeel was 50/100; preserve the two source scales separately.

air_quality.indoor_controls: Doors and windows closed with air filters operating.
air_quality.guardrail: The indoor value is exposure context, not proof of zero respiratory risk.

session_contract_review.clean_air_controls_and_indoor_pm2_5: Athlete reports outdoor PM2.5 91.2 ug/m3, indoor PM2.5 below 30 ug/m3, doors and windows closed, and air filters operating.
session_contract_review.repetition_average_power_hr_cadence_and_: Garmin repetitions were 169 W / 140 bpm / 70 rpm, 168 W / 145 bpm / 68 rpm, and 168 W / 150 bpm / 70 rpm. Athlete reported the repetitions collectively at approximately RPE 8/10; separate rep-by-rep RPE values were not supplied.
session_contract_review.technical_quality_notes: Indoor seated tempo/torque execution. Power and cadence were objectively captured; posture, fit symptoms and local-leg versus breathing limitation were not yet reported.
session_contract_review.coach_contract_mapping: The athlete explicitly reported exceeding the repetition-two RPE ceiling and continuing. This maps to triggered_but_continued under the written contract, but the canonical stop_rule_outcome remains unset until Clayton explicitly confirms the structured label.

objective_interval_evidence.source: Garmin activity 24105394715 standard activity, split and FIT surfaces
objective_interval_evidence.power_zone_context: Approximately 21.2 minutes in Garmin power zone 3, 27 seconds in zone 4 and 4 seconds in zone 5; this was not a conventional VO2max interval dose.
objective_interval_evidence.interpretation: External work matched the written power dose closely, while HR rose progressively at near-identical power. The elevated perceived effort therefore requires separation of local muscular torque strain, breathing strain and global RPE rather than reclassifying the session as VO2max work.

coach_contract_audit.written_action: Three seated eight-minute repetitions at 165-168 W, 70-75 rpm and RPE 5-6 with four-minute recoveries; end the structured set if repetition two already exceeded RPE 6.
coach_contract_audit.executed_action: Three complete eight-minute repetitions at 169/168/168 W and 70/68/70 rpm with complete recoveries; athlete reported approximately RPE 8 and continued after the RPE ceiling was exceeded.
coach_contract_audit.load_alignment: Garmin load 75.0 matched the written expected range of 40-90.
coach_contract_audit.calibration_disposition: Not eligible for true digital-twin calibration unless an explicit valid stop outcome is supplied; if confirmed as triggered_but_continued, the nominal prescription remains ineligible despite matched external dose and Garmin load.
coach_contract_audit.next_constraint: No VO2, threshold, Twin Peaks or other meaningful-cost session on 2026-08-26. Use rest or genuinely easy continuity only, then reassess absorption before the protected Friday Enduro exposure.
